messages.subject: Kingsmoor House - EXCHANGED
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Marcus,

Contracts exchanged on Kingsmoor House at 3.05pm today (Formula B). Completion is set for 1 May 2026. Deposit of £1,415,000 sent to the Seller's solicitors as stakeholder. Congratulations. We'll now move to completion.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0500
